disallow.description: List of issue codes that should fail policy enforcement

blocklist.description: Alias for disallow; kept for backward compatibility

publisher_expectations.description: Expected publisher or source string for specific dependencies

trusted_registries.description: Allowed dependency registries (e.g., pypi, npm, internal registry hostnames)

protected_namespaces.description: Namespaces reserved for internal packages to detect dependency confusion

require_dependency_signatures.description: Require signature metadata on dependencies when available

required_approvals.description: Approval tags required for policy compliance (e.g., security, compliance)

lockfile_checksums.description: Expected SHA256 checksums for lockfiles (path -> sha256)

require_lockfile_checksums.description: Require checksums for all detected lockfiles

config_checksums.description: Expected SHA256 checksums for config files (path -> sha256)

ruleset_checksums.description: Expected SHA256 checksums for ruleset files (path -> sha256)

plugin_signatures.description: Expected SHA256 signatures for plugins/extensions (path -> sha256)

enforce_graph_policies.description: Whether to enforce default graph-based AI stack policies

scoring_model_version.description: Version identifier for the scoring model

category_weights.description: Normalized category weights for weighted scoring (sum to 1.0)

org_weights.description: Org-specific weights for risk categories (category -> penalty)

temporal_multipliers.description: Multipliers for exploit maturity signals (active_exploitation, mature, poc)

missing_intel_penalty.description: Penalty applied when required intel signals are missing

active_exploitation_penalty.description: Minimum penalty applied when active exploitation is detected

policy_version.description: Policy version identifier for audit trails

change_log.description: Change log entries for policy updates
